name: travel-reliability
description: Open contracts, evidence and recovery workflows for travel.

scripts.security:fuzz: node --import tsx security/fuzz/typescript.ts --seed 20261030 --cases 13000 --seconds 120 --output .local/security-audit/fuzz/typescript.json && uv run --project ingest python security/fuzz/ingest.py --seed 20261030 --cases 384 --seconds 120 --output .local/security-audit/fuzz/ingest.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-offline.mjs && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:python: uv run --project ingest python -m pytest ingest/tests
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:python && npm run privacy:check
scripts.ingest: uv run --directory ingest python -m uvicorn travel_ingest.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081 --no-access-log
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project ingest ruff check ingest/travel_ingest ingest/tests
scripts.security:fuzz:ecosystem: node --import tsx security/fuzz/ecosystem.ts --seed 20261031 --cases 2000 --seconds 120 && uv run --project ingest python security/fuzz/email_import.py --seed 20261031 --cases 384 --seconds 120
